description: This PHP class 'GenericBasicDisplayField' defines a display field for reporting purposes within the OrangeHRM system. It extends 'BasicDisplayField' and provides a mapping for various employee-related fields such as personal info, contact details, job info, and custom fields. The class includes methods to set display field properties based on a display field object, utilizing a predefined mapping array.
